title: Flame Bold Caps Usage
slide_intent: Limit emphatic uppercase treatments to short messages so their visual force does not make longer reading tiring.
strategic_value: The large two-line all-caps example can give Burger King a strong announcement voice within a controlled exception to ordinary setting.
demonstration: ALL CAPS HEADLINE appears in two large cream lines on red beside the three-word limit and 75% leading rule.
practical_value: Use the uppercase exception only for an eligible short headline and set its leading from the stated percentage.

content_islands.name: Caps rule
content_islands.spec: Place the compact usage guidance at upper left.

content_islands.name: Headline specimen
content_islands.spec: Fill the lower-right area with the two-line uppercase example.

ingredient.name: Flame Bold all-caps headline
ingredient.role: Create concentrated emphasis for a short message.
ingredient.application: Use for specific layouts of three words or fewer; set headline leading to 75% of point size.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. An optional short-message treatment, not the default for all copy.

reference_purposes.Application: The specimen demonstrates a three-word all-caps headline.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page permits all-caps Flame Bold for specific layouts with three words or fewer and sets leading at 75% of point size.
